body:
> Hmmm, it is the goal responsibility of the searchbox? Because having a submit button means you have a wrapping <form> as well. Good point but not sure how to fix it :/

Well we can have a wrapping form or not, that's not mandatory. You can add just a button type submit and handle the submit on it. Or we can have a wrapping form, we have one for example in the priceRanges widget.

But that's for later
